mapper.sql: TRIM(EMPCD) AS EMPCD, TRIM(HNAME) AS HNAME, TRIM(DEPTCDNM) AS DEPTCDNM, TRIM(HANDPHONE) AS HANDPHONE, TRIM(EMAIL) AS EMAIL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT FROM IS_USER_INFO_SSO_V WHERE TRIM(EMPCD) = #{employeeCode} FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT FROM IS_USER_INFO_SSO_V WHERE TRIM(EMPCD) = #{pid} OR (INSTR(TRIM(EMAIL), '@') > 1 AND LOWER(SUBSTR(TRIM(EMAIL), 1, INSTR(TRIM(EMAIL), '@') - 1)) = LOWER(#{pid})) FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY
